name: Poison Touch
description: Make an unarmed melee attack against a creature within Reach. On a hit, it takes 1d4+BODY damage, and for the next minute, it must roll Fortitude against a difficulty of 10 at the start of each of its turns, taking 1d4 damage on each loss.
successes:
✨: +1d damage for the initial attack.

🌞: +1d damage for the initial attack and ongoing effect.
